laws.name: Income tax (top rate)
laws.rubric: Top marginal rate on wage (ordinary) income for a single filer, in percent. 0 for states with no wage income tax, including a tax on capital gains only (WA).

laws.name: Income tax structure
laws.rubric: none = no tax on wage income (a capital-gains-only tax counts as none). flat = one rate. graduated = more than one bracket rate for a single filer.

laws.name: Sales tax (state + avg local)
laws.rubric: State rate plus population-weighted average local rate.

laws.name: Groceries: sales tax treatment
laws.rubric: exempt = groceries not taxed by the state (includes states with no sales tax). reduced = a state rate on groceries below the general rate. taxed = groceries in the general sales tax base. Local grocery taxes are not counted. The reduced rate is recorded in notes.

laws.name: Electricity price
laws.rubric: Average residential retail price for the latest complete calendar year, cents per kWh.

laws.name: Minimum wage
laws.rubric: EFFECTIVE floor for non-tipped adult employees: max(state statutory rate, federal 7.25). States with no law or a sub-federal rate get 7.25 because FLSA-covered employers must pay it. Record the statutory rate in notes.

laws.name: Marijuana
laws.rubric: From NCSL's tables: recreational = comprehensive program with adult (non-medical) use allowed. medical = comprehensive medical program, no adult use. cbd_only = only in NCSL's low-THC/CBD program table. illegal = in neither table.

laws.name: Abortion access
laws.rubric: From KFF's status categories: banned = 'Abortion banned'. restricted = a gestational limit at or before 12 weeks LMP. limited = a limit after 12 weeks but before viability (KFF's 15/18-22 week group). protected = 'at or near viability' or 'No gestational limits'. KFF's category text and notes are kept in notes.

laws.name: Permitless carry
laws.rubric: true if a permit is not required to carry a concealed handgun.
